''See also: [[Sky's Edge Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Sky's Edge is a seaside location characterized by a powerful ice [[aura]] and strong [[earth aura]], the latter of which has petrified nearby trees. The area features a [[fortress]] built by the [[Seishen Kingdom]] near a town of the same name, though much of the settlement has been devastated. A massive, dark [[stone]] hand belonging to a sleeping [[Wandering Titan]] rests across the shore, with its fingers crushing several houses and its body occupying the bay like an island. The region is currently a site of significant danger, as a [[Dreadgod]] is feeding there and the [[Titan]] threatens to wake. Objectives in the area include securing a mine, protecting survivors, clearing out [[dreadbeasts]], and evacuating the remaining citizens. Access to the territory is managed through a [[portal]] or gate that can manifest as a [[pillar of darkness]] stretching into the clouds.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sky's Edge serves as the arrival point for the [[Akura expedition]] and is a location characterized by powerful ice and earth auras. The area becomes the site where the [[Abyssal Palace]] hovers, drawing a flight of [[dragons]] toward the continent to face combatants on the battlefield. As a destination for the group approaching by [[cloudship]], the location offers various prizes but remains a place that [[Aunt Charity]] cannot reach alone. The site contains a [[fortress]] raised by the Seishen King{{!}}Seishen king, where [[Fury]] and others find themselves pinned. Within this landscape of ruined homes and a visible [[stone]] hand, crates are recovered containing items from mines or enemies.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Reached via a [[portal]], Sky's Edge was once a seaside town that served as a battlefield for Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara and [[Lindon]]. During the conflict, [[Charity]] expanded the location's gate into a vast screen of darkness. The town was ultimately destroyed, and the [[Wandering Titan]] even took a stride across the space where Sky's Edge had formerly existed. Later, the titan was observed sleeping in the bay outside the site.}}
